faq.question: Q1. What is Kamdhenu University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Kamdhenu University Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification released for filling 6 vacancies of Teaching Associate and Senior Research Fellow on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply or attend the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26-10-2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in any discipline of Veterinary Science & A.H., or an M.V.Sc. with minimum 60% marks and three years of experience along with one published research paper in SCI or NAAS-rated journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is max 35 years for male candidates and max 40 years for female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are requested to appear for a walk-in interview with an application on plain paper, complete bio-data, all documents, and self-attested photocopies at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test to shortlist candidates if the number of applicants is higher, followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The fellowship amount is Rs. 61,000 per month + HRA for Master's degree holders and Rs. 67,000 per month + HRA for Ph.D. degree holders.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the College of Veterinary Science & A.H., Kamdhenu University, Navsari.
